parameters.ring: src.robustness.ring_mask: 50-150 m, common mask, all saved candidates excluded
parameters.statistic: candidate (or placement) median change minus ring median change, seed interval, raw

limitations: Descriptive comparison, not a significance test and not evidence of a physical cause.
Candidates were selected for large change in this interval; random regions were not, so the comparison is incomplete and a candidate looking unusual is expected.
Nearby placements are not independent (spatial autocorrelation); the 100 m minimum spacing is a simplification.
No multiple-comparison correction across the five candidates or two channels.
No independent reference; nothing confirms water, flooding or land-cover change.
